Hi Sally —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attaching an initial MAP draft that ties evaluation gates to marketplace private-offer activation and invoice milestones. High-level notes below; details are in the PDF.

Key points:
1) Evaluation gates (timeline estimates):
   - Week 1 (P0) – API smoke test & basic latency check (internal dev + MedixCore sandbox)
   - Week 2 (Security) – SOC2 checklist + encryption/KMS verification (legal & security)
   - Week 3 (Perf) – 24-hr perf window, KV cache profile, & cost-per-token baseline
   - Week 4 (Acceptance) – Final signoff and production enablement

2) Marketplace activation mapping:
   - AWS private offer will be provisioned at "Acceptance" (Week 4) and queued for billing on the next AWS invoice cycle (see note on billing path).
   - GCP equivalent (private commit) will be provisioned in parallel if they choose GCP lane; timing and invoice alignment are identical in the MAP.

3) Billing path & PO timing:
   - MedixCore PO issued on acceptance triggers Redwood to confirm private-offer activation and send invoice.
   - For AWS marketplace, invoicing follows AWS billing ledger; expected customer invoice delivery 3–7 business days post-activation.
   - If MedixCore requires invoice prior to activation, we can support a pre-activation invoice on a committed volume (requires procurement legal approval).

Next steps: Laura will coordinate with billing to confirm exact invoice lead times; Aditya will update the MAP to include milestones with owners and Slack/RBAC contacts.

I attached: 20290429-MedixCore-MAP-draft.pdf, pricing-breakdown-aws-gcp-azure.csv, and a PO template for your procurement team to review.

Best,
Tessa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Summary from billing ops:
- AWS private-offer activation -> invoice appears in AWS billing ledger within 1–5 business days in 85% of cases; rare outliers (5–10 business days) when AWS performs reconciliation.
- If MedixCore needs invoice before private-offer activation, we can issue a pro-forma invoice for a committed minimum spend; legal will need to sign off on terms (pre-invoice = special handling).
- For GCP/Azure marketplace lanes, timelines are similar but GCP sometimes takes an extra clearance day for partner reporting.
